occurrence.reason: The retained dependency-cruiser output has no physical source positions; preserve source-bound occurrences as audit evidence only until a separately validated position extractor is frozen.

metrics.precision: TP/(TP+FP); null with reason when denominator is zero
metrics.recall: TP/(TP+FN); null with reason when denominator is zero
metrics.f1: null unless precision and recall are estimable; zero when both are estimable and P+R=0; otherwise 2PR/(P+R)
metrics.conservative_exact_case_success: complete truth and valid exactly matching base/head edge sets/56

paired_policy: Use the pre-output common-capability set; retain every unsupported, failed and truth-Unknown attempt in coverage.
zero_positive_policy: Never report 100% recall when TP+FN is zero.
agreement: Compare two sealed original inventories before adjudication; preserve unresolved differences as Unknown.
